subject: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@greenpath.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline

Hi Elena (and team),

Quick note to lock timelines for the GreenPath Q4 upsell so Finance can include this in the Nov forecast. We need a clear commit signal (signed SOW or DocuSign) by EOD Tuesday, Nov 17 to pull this into the week-47 numbers.

What we need from GreenPath this week:
- Confirmation of tier: 12k-seat expansion (same unit pricing) or final adjustment
- Signed SOW (attached) OR DocuSign completion by 11/17 EOD
- Any billing/payment changes (NET terms) that require Finance approval

Internal asks: Priyom/Karthik — if we have the signed SOW by Tue 11/17, can ops/finance treat this as a Commit for the November forecast? Monica/Lauren — please flag any billing constraints that would push recognition beyond Dec.

I've attached the latest SOW draft and the usage report you asked for. Elena, if you can confirm the sign date and any remaining redlines, we'll mark the deal as Commit in HubSpot and roll into the forecast.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

[attachments: GreenPath_SOW_v2.pdf, usage_report_q3.csv]

----- Reply (Elena Ruiz) -----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@greenpath.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenPath Finance <finops@greenpath.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:45:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline

Camila — thanks for the clear ask. Good news: leadership gave verbal approval for the 12k-seat tier this morning. I've uploaded the signed SOW (minor edits accepted) and the usage report for Q3. Finance intends to complete the DocuSign by Monday 11/16; I'll push for EOD Tuesday at the latest.

Two quick items: 1) We requested a 15-day NET rather than NET30; is that acceptable? 2) One minor redline on the start date — we requested a December 1 effective date.

I'll post the DocuSign link when it's complete.

Best,
Elena
Head of Strategic Accounts | GreenPath Inc.
elena@greenpath.ai

[attachments: GreenPath_SOW_v2.pdf, usage_report_q3.csv]

----- Reply (Priyom Das) -----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline

Thanks — marking action items. Quick operational question for the thread: is GreenPath giving an explicit commit ("we will sign by 11/17") or is this still approval-in-principle? We need the explicit commit to count in the closed-forecast.

Actionables for internal team:
- Camila: capture the DocuSign link and confirmation email when signed
- Karthik: confirm whether start-date shift to Dec 1 affects seat activation timing for revenue recognition
- Monica/Lauren: note any billing terms that would delay recognition past Dec 2026

If we don't have a signed DocuSign by 11/17 EOD, we should leave it in Upside and not include in the locked forecast.

Priyom
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

----- Reply (Karthik Iyer) -----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline

Agree with Priyom. For forecasting clarity I recommend we:
- Move this to Commit in HubSpot if DocuSign is completed by EOD 11/17
- If start date is Dec 1, revenue recognition may shift for the first invoice — finance should flag whether this impacts the Nov accruals
- If GreenPath requests NET15, Finance should confirm acceptance (Lauren/Monica).

I'll update the deal stage and add a note linking to our pipeline playbook so RevOps knows the gating criteria. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/GP-2026-EXP-042

Karthik
VP, Revenue Strategy | Redwood Inference

----- Reply (Elena Ruiz) -----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@greenpath.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenPath Finance <finops@greenpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: GreenPath upsell triage and commit timeline

Hi Camila — doc signed and sent via DocuSign (link below). GreenPath Finance accepted NET15 and the Dec 1 effective date is confirmed. Minor redline was administrative only and accepted by your legal team.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/abc123-greenpath-sow

Please mark the deal as Commit in your forecast. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

Kind regards,
Elena
Head of Strategic Accounts | GreenPath Inc.

[attachments: docusign_greenpath_sow_link.url]
